q: Do iron ore pellets count electricity emissions under CBAM?
title: Pellets and sinter: electricity counts
short: Yes. Sintered ore, which includes pellets under CN 2601 12 00, is the one iron and steel good not listed in Annex II, so its electricity emissions count. Steel goods made from pellets carry those indirect emissions in their own figure too.
audience: Indian pellet plant operators and the steel mills buying their pellets for EU export products

ul: Direct emissions from induration fuel and additives.
Indirect emissions from electricity used for grinding and balling.
Output in tonnes for the calendar year.

p: Pellets are a precursor for pig iron and DRI. Their full embedded emissions, electricity included, flow into the mill's figure even though the mill's own electricity is not counted.
Non-agglomerated ore is not a CBAM good and carries no embedded emissions into the figure.
